steps.instruction: Pay Apex Components (lowest unit price 324.43 USD) 7 units x 324.43 = 2271.01 USD to account ACCT-ACX-1341 with memo 'purchase order'. Dynamo Parts (366.72) and Granite Works (504.82) are more expensive and not chosen.
Set KV key order/vendor to Apex Components after the payment succeeds.
Set KV key order/total to 2271.01 (7 x 324.43, two decimals).

steps.content: Order confirmation: vendor Apex Components, total 2271.01 USD. Use the total value stored in KV order/total.
